newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner has no comment on TCI deals.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner has no comment on TCI deals.

text.p: Time Warner Inc had no comment on a Wall Street Journal report that Tele-Communications Inc was close to executing a series of cable system partnerships with Time and others that would allow TCI to lower its debt.
Under the reported proposals, TCI would cut debt by more than $1.1 billion and would shrink its subscriber base by 800,000, the newspaper said. TCI officials were not immediately available.
The Journal said that TCI would dispose of cable systems in markets it does not dominate, and that the new partners may benefit from managing systems that abut markets they already serve.

TCI would be a minority partner in the ventures, which include TCA Cable TV Inc, Falcon Cable Systems LP and Charter Communications International Inc, the Journal said. TCA and Falcon officials were not immediately available for comment. Charter officials could not be reached.
If Time Warner and TCI agree to a cable venture, the deal would not bring additional debt to Time, according to a source close to Time.
